title: Registry log event (schema v1)
description: One line of log/registry.log.jsonl — the append-only, hash-chained event log that is the institution's spine. Hashing rules: schema/CANONICAL.md.

seq.description: 0 for GENESIS, then strictly +1 per event.

registry_id.description: Required for every type except GENESIS.

data.description: Event payload. For VERSION_ENTERED: version, kind, content_hash. For ENROLLED: verification tier/era. For GENESIS: hashes of the founding documents.

prev_hash.description: hash of the previous event; 64 zeros for GENESIS.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this event with the hash field absent.

signature.description: Optional in the founding era; reserved for institution keys.
